rationale: Recovery and resynchronization was the one mechanism along the audit axes with no execution so far. This experiment stops a member, commits an entry while it is down, restarts it from the storage the driver kept up to date, advances the clock so the leader issues heartbeats, and records whether the member recovers the entry it never saw, relearns the leader, and can propose again.

investigations.question: After a member is stopped and restarted from its persisted storage while the group commits new entries, does it recover the committed state it missed, relearn the leader, and regain the ability to propose, without diverging from the group's applied log?
investigations.hypothesis: The restarted instance reloads Term, Vote and Commit from its storage, learns the current leader from the leader's heartbeats, fetches the entries committed while it was down through the ordinary append path, applies them, and re-arms its proposal gate when it observes the leader, so it returns to full participation.
investigations.discriminator: In the three-node Node-API cluster: commit a payload to all nodes, stop node 2, commit a second payload while it is down, restart node 2 from its MemoryStorage, advance the logical clock ten rounds with delivery between rounds, then record whether node 2 sees leader 1, whether the missed payload appears in its applied entries and on all nodes, and whether a proposal from the restarted node returns and commits.

scope.description: Three real raft nodes (ids 1,2,3) driven through the async Node API in one process, with per-node MemoryStorage kept up to date by the driver (HardState and appended entries). Node 1 is elected, a payload is committed on all three nodes, node 2 is stopped, a second payload is committed while it is down, node 2 is restarted from its storage by rebuilding a raft instance on the same storage, the logical clock is advanced in ten rounds with delivery between rounds, and then the harness records the restarted node's leader, its applied entries, the recovered payload's presence on every node, and a subsequent proposal from node 2.
assumptions: The storage directory equivalent is the same MemoryStorage instance, so the restart sees exactly what the driver persisted: HardState on every Ready and all appended entries.
No snapshot is taken, so the restarted member catches up through the ordinary append path rather than by installing a snapshot.
The clock is advanced after the restart because a restarted member otherwise has no traffic from the leader with which to learn it; this is a property of the harness, not of the target.
Membership is unchanged in this scenario, so the storage's ConfState stays valid across the restart.
excluded: Snapshot installation and storage loss at the restarted member
Multiple simultaneous restarts and crash-stop during the restart
Message loss, ticks during the outage, and membership changes

experiment.prefix: Start nodes 1,2,3 with a MemoryStorage per node whose ConfState voters are {1,2,3}. Node 1 campaigns at term 1 and becomes leader; every node reports leader 1 and node 1 has applied the initial entry. Propose a payload on node 1 and wait until all three nodes have applied it. Stop node 2 and record its committed and applied indexes. Propose a second payload on node 1 and wait until it is applied by the remaining nodes. Rebuild node 2 from its MemoryStorage and run it again, then advance the clock ten rounds with delivery between rounds. Wait until node 2 reports leader 1 and until the payload it never saw appears in its applied entries, then confirm the payload's presence on all nodes and propose a further payload from node 2, waiting for its commit.
experiment.responsibility: Recovery obligation of the library: a member restarted from persisted state must reconstruct the committed log, learn the current leader and return to proposing, without applying a divergent history.

comparisons.description: The restarted member recovered the payload committed while it was down, after reporting leader 1.
A proposal from the restarted member returned rather than staying pending, so its gate was armed after it relearned the leader.
The restarted member's proposal was committed.
